faqClient.q: How do I place an order?
faqClient.a: Open the Explore tab, choose a restaurant, add dishes to your cart, then tap "Order". Make sure you have a delivery address in your profile.

faqClient.q: I haven't received my order, what should I do?
faqClient.a: First check the status in the Orders tab. If the order is marked "delivered" but you haven't received it, contact support immediately via this form.

faqClient.q: How do I cancel an order?
faqClient.a: Cancellation is only possible within 2 minutes of ordering, as long as the restaurant hasn't accepted it yet. Go to Orders → your order → Cancel.

faqClient.q: My card was charged but the order doesn't show up?
faqClient.a: It can take up to 5 minutes. If after 10 minutes the order still doesn't appear, contact support with the amount and time of the charge.

faqClient.q: How do I change my delivery address?
faqClient.a: Go to Profile → My info → Address. You can edit the address before placing an order. Addresses cannot be changed after confirmation.

faqClient.q: How do I get a refund?
faqClient.a: Refunds are processed within 3–5 business days. Use the complaint form below describing the issue. A photo proof may be requested.

faqClient.q: Are displayed dishes available in real time?
faqClient.a: Yes, availability is updated by the restaurant. If a dish is marked unavailable when you order, the restaurant will contact you to offer a replacement.

faqClient.q: How do I track my delivery?
faqClient.a: In the Orders tab, tap your ongoing order to see real-time status and the driver's position on the map.

faqRestaurant.q: How do I add dishes to my menu?
faqRestaurant.a: From your Dashboard → Menu → Add a dish. You can enter the name, description, price, category and a photo.

faqRestaurant.q: How do I turn my restaurant on/off?
faqRestaurant.a: In Restaurant Settings, the "Open/Closed" button changes your status in real time. Customers cannot order from a closed restaurant.

faqRestaurant.q: How do I see my statistics?
faqRestaurant.a: The Analytics tab on your dashboard shows revenue, orders and best-selling dishes.

faqRestaurant.q: How do I receive my payments?
faqRestaurant.a: Payments are transferred weekly to the bank account you provided at sign-up. Check your info in Settings → Payment.

faqLivreur.q: How do I start a delivery mission?
faqLivreur.a: Turn on your "Available" status in your driver dashboard. Available orders in your area will show up automatically.

faqLivreur.q: How do I report a problem during a delivery?
faqLivreur.a: On the active mission page, tap "Report a problem". Describe the situation — our team will contact you quickly.

faqLivreur.q: How do I see my earnings?
faqLivreur.a: Driver dashboard → Earnings tab. Payments are made weekly.
